slides.narration: Let's solve Reverse Words In String, a medium strings problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Reverse the order of space-separated words, preserving all whitespace runs.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Manual scan from the end collecting tokens → O(n)
In-place: reverse all, then reverse each word
slides.narration: The library approach is fine but may lose spacing. Scanning from the end, collecting words and space runs, is linear. In place, reverse the whole string then each word.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, tokenise into words and spaces. Second, reverse the token list. Third, join back.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: We scan from the end, and whenever we switch between space and non-space we append the token from i plus one to end, then move end.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n. Space is O of n.

slides.narration: Preserve runs of spaces and leading or trailing spaces.
